title: Toddler Boy in Toy Wagon, Backyard Overalls - Vintage 1950s Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: A candid outdoor snapshot of a young blonde toddler sitting inside a pull wagon in a residential yard alongside a house. The child wears a light-colored summer romper or overalls while holding onto the wagon's handle. In the softly blurred background, utility poles, a neighbor's house, and a vintage automobile from the late 1940s or early 1950s are visible under an overcast sky.
